{{Quote|There is a group of marauders who would like nothing more than to hijack my master's cargo. So far my men have been ineffective against them.|[[Rigosso/Legends|Rigosso]] to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Bounty (episode)">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Kage Warriors''' were [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] fighters who opposed the tyrannical ruler [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] on the [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The warriors were skilled in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed martial arts]] and used [[Electro sword/Legends|electro swords]] as their primary weapons. They also utilized the [[Milodon/Legends|milodon]] as a transport that could keep up with a [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]]. [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]] was the leader of the warriors. They were known to have raided a subtram containing Krismo's sister, [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]].

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Kage Warrior" likely comes from the Japanese word "kage", meaning "shadow". This is due to their clear ninja influence.
